ms.promise:

ms.report:
The prototype of the RWA-backed On-chain Lending and Auctioning Protocol has been developed on the Preprod Network demonstrating key functionalities:
・Listing with a minimum bid, multiple competitive bids, finalizing the auction with the highest bid and canceling the listing if no bids are received.
・Collateralized lending process, including collateral deposit, loan issuance, and repayment.
・Loan default process and the lender claiming the collateral in case of default.

A detailed testing report with all test cases and their preprod transactions links can be found here - https://elderly-hammer-b9c.notion.site/Test-Report-for-RWA-backed-On-chain-Lending-and-Auctioning-Protocol-111e8a72de3680fd870ddbdbfe90b9c6?pvs=4
Low Fidelity Prototype Link - https://rwa-lending-app.vercel.app/
